Class OnePointCrossover

Namespace
GeneticSharp.Domain.Crossovers
Assembly
LBS.dll
One-Point crossover (C1). A single crossover point on both parents is selected. All data beyond that point in either is swapped between the two parents. One-point crossover Parents: |0|0|0| x |1|1|1| Have two swap points indexes: 0 and 1.

1) new OnePointCrossover(0); Children result: |0|1|1| and |1|0|0|

2) new OnePointCrossover(1); Children result: |0|0|1| and |1|1|0| 

public class OnePointCrossover : CrossoverBase, ICrossover, IChromosomeOperator
